name: Mac 4 Breakfast
soft_passes: #2 grid: visual weight split between battery and device row, no single optical-centre anchor
#6 palette: 5-hue device row spends saturation away from focal battery, but contained in a pill
#10 variant: white+green battery survives tint/dark, but colour-only device row would flatten to one tone under tinted/mono
failures: #4 16px squint: only the green battery bar survives; lightning bolt smears into the fill and the 5-dot device row degrades to a colour smudge — a communicated feature lost at menu-bar size
light_model: soft top-down (Big Sur baked-shadow); short micro-shadow lifts the battery frame off the field; green fill lighter at top (#87ECB1) -> darker base (#2CC071); no hard specular, no glass refraction
layer_stack: off-white battery frame + soft drop shadow
devices: menu-bar device row (frosted capsule of 5 colour-coded dots under the hero object)
literal charging metaphor (green fill + white lightning-bolt knockout)
complementary field-vs-object contrast (violet-blue field, green object)
rhymes_hint: menu-bar power-utility family (Bartender, iStat Menus, AlDente, CleanMyMac): single system-object on a saturated gradient field, front-facing, soft micro-shadow — Big Sur object-on-gradient cluster
notes: 256x256 web render, pre-masked with alpha (transparent corners) — green ramp and dot hues reliable; fine micro-shadow/specular not judgeable at this scale; content sits ~6% inside so mask edge not fully readable. Strong icon<->product palette coherence: violet-blue field + green status recur in wordmark, 'Native for macOS' green pill, and the app's green charging chip on the cover. Translucent device-row capsule is a mild glass quote but the icon is Big Sur object-language, not Icon-Composer Liquid Glass; the device row is the element that would break under Liquid Glass tinted/mono appearances.
